body.cap: The Hurotics booth at CES 2025 in Las Vegas, USA | Photo by AVING News

body.x: Hurotics (CEO Giuk Lee), a medical, wellness, and sports wearable robot suit specialist, captured global visitors' attention at CES 2025 with its innovative technology.

At this exhibition, Hurotics showcased the sports wearable robot "H-Fit" and the "H-Medi" rehabilitation device," demonstrating how personalized robotic technology has become integrated into daily life.

The most popular program at the Hurotics booth was the H-Fit experience event. H-Fit is a sports wearable robot designed to maximize athletes' performance. Visitors could test it in a sprint challenge against a Korean national track and field athlete.

The event, held from 10 a.m. to 12 p.m., offered an exciting challenge. Participants who beat the athlete's record received a $3,000 prize. Visitors who participated remarked, "It was not just a simple technology demonstration but a new experience combining sports and technology."

The H-Medi experience event took place from 2 to 5 p.m. H-Medi, a double winner of the CES Innovation Award, is a wearable robot that introduces a new paradigm in rehabilitation through AI-based personalized gait support technology and a cable-driven system.

Visitors personally wore the robot, experiencing its natural movements and comfortable fit. Many expressed surprise, saying, "I didn't expect rehabilitation therapy to become so simple and accessible daily." H-Medi received high praise for its ability to adjust flexibly to various patient physiques and symptoms and its lightweight design that allows use without environmental or location constraints.

body.cap: The H-Fit experience event featured a sports wearable robot designed to maximize athletes' performance. | Photo by AVING News

body.x: Through special experience events at CES 2025, Hurotics emphasized the innovation and practicality of its technology. The booth in Hall D of the Venetian Expo in Las Vegas continuously attracted visitors from the opening day.

A representative from Hurotics stated, "H-Fit and H-Medi are products that will redefine the future of sports performance and rehabilitation therapy. We are pleased to show visitors through these experience events how robotic technology has come so close to individuals' lives."

At CES 2025, Hurotics demonstrated that wearable robot technology can practically change individuals' lives in sports and medical fields, going beyond mere technological demonstrations. The innovative products and experience programs impressed visitors with the realization that robotic technology is no longer a distant future concept. One attendee commented, "It's amazing that robotic technology in sports and rehabilitation feels so realistic. H-Fit and H-Medi are not just devices but companions that enhance the quality of life."

As a leading company in the wearable robot field, Hurotics plans to further solidify its position in the global market through its participation in CES 2025. Through ongoing innovation, the company aims to develop practical, user-friendly robots that anyone can use.
